cohort: The study included 159 postnatal mothers with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy who delivered between March 31, 2023 and May 31, 2023 at the Adabraka Polyclinic in Ghana.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression among the cohort was 46.5%, with informal occupation, Ga ethnicity, sub-optimal financial support from partner, and experience of cesarean section identified as independent risk factors.
mod_finding: Experience of cesarean section was found to be independently associated with a significantly higher risk of postpartum depression.
cross-section timing: During the postnatal period for mothers who delivered between March 31, 2023 and May 31, 2023.
